newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Blue chips push Mauritius bourse index down.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips push Mauritius bourse index down.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius index Semdex fell 1.22 points on Wednesday to 379.24 reflecting declines in a range of blue chips and a continuing subdued market, bourse officials said.
Turnover rose to 10.77 million rupees on 262,532 shares from 5.52 million rupees on 172,339 shares on last Monday.
Hotel-based Sun Resorts lost 1.20 rupees to 47.40 on 116,000 shares, New Mauritius Hotels was stable at 37.20 on 18,150 shares and Grand Baie Hotel was unchanged to 50 on 140 shares.

In the commerce sector, conglomerate Rogers eased 2.0 to 93 on 300 shares and Ireland Blyth Ltd was unchanged at 15.80 but was not traded. National carrier Air Mauritius lost 1.10 to 35.40 on 3,060 shares.
The State Bank of Mauritius rose 20 cents to 12.70 on 56,300 shares and Mauritius Commercial Bank remained unchanged to 90.00 rupees on 30,640 shares.
Sugar concern Mon Tresor Mon Desert (MTMD) was 10 cents down to 38.90 on 8,510 shares whereas Harel Freres was stable at 55.00 rupees on 5,100 shares.
